address: 32 The Promenade, King Street Wharf 5, Sydney NSW 2000
capacity_note: Ceremony and reception or reception only: up to 260 seated or 440 cocktail. Intimate weddings up to 50 seated on the private mezzanine.
price_note: No base price published; package lengths 3h, 4h and 5.5h, 20% deposit. Ask for a quote.
editorial_summary: A glass-roofed vessel that sails the harbour for the whole wedding, with the ceremony, canapés and dinner all on board. The in-house chef and crew run the day, and a smaller private upper level suits intimate groups. Alcohol must come from the boat (no BYO).

capacity_note: Largest vessel (Starship Sydney): 440 at tables, 950 cocktail. Fleet runs from 10-guest to 950-guest boats.
price_note: Hourly charter, typically 4-hour minimum: from about $1,440 for the smallest boat to $10,000 for large superyachts; 50% deposit. Third-party operator figures, confirm before booking.
editorial_summary: A charter company with eleven vessels from a 10-guest cruiser to a 950-guest function boat, including a classic ferry and a superyacht. Each wedding gets a coordinator, ceremonies on board are allowed, and some boats allow your own food and drink. Pick-ups are possible from many harbour wharves.

capacity_note: Largest vessel (Bella Vista): 280 seated, 750 cocktail. Smaller options from 36 guests (yachts) to 200 (Aussie Magic catamaran).
price_note: Hourly rates published per vessel, roughly $975 to $3,250 per hour; a 5-hour wedding package is offered, price on request.
editorial_summary: A harbour charter operator whose five-hour wedding package covers a vessel with wraparound decks, a sky deck for the ceremony and photos, and a private upper bar. Fleet choices range from 36-guest yachts to a 750-guest cocktail boat.

address: Campbell's Cove Wharf 2 Pontoon, The Rocks NSW 2000
capacity_note: Capacity not published; described as suitable for large groups.
editorial_summary: Traditional timber tall ships sailing from The Rocks, offered for ceremonies, receptions, guest transfers or a photos-only sail. A floating dance floor and live music or DJ are available. Fleet names, capacity and pricing are not published, so these need an enquiry.

capacity_note: Harbour Spirit: 130 formal dining (140 on the contact page), 200 cocktail; minimum 70 guests.
price_note: Reception packages from $179 per person with a 70-guest minimum; decorations and wharf fees extra.
editorial_summary: A single catamaran running four-hour reception cruises with food, drinks, DJ and styling items included in a per-person package. A celebrant can be arranged for a ceremony on deck or inside. Best for larger weddings because of the 70-guest minimum.

capacity_note: Largest vessel (Fantasea Catalina) holds up to 399 in total; seated/standing split not published.
price_note: No prices published; quote on request.
editorial_summary: A Sydney Harbour charter fleet departing from Darling Harbour or Circular Quay, with vessels from about 30 up to 399 guests. Setup is flexible and pick-up is possible from several wharves; pricing is quoted per enquiry.

capacity_note: Listing spans vessels from 14 to about 300 guests; per-vessel seated/standing not published.
price_note: Hourly rates from about $330 (small boats) up to $3,600 (large superyachts); includes classic timber boats around $600-$850 per hour.
editorial_summary: A boat-hire marketplace listing dozens of Sydney vessels, including a square-rigged tall ship, a classic ferry and a 1960s timber cruiser alongside modern catamarans and superyachts. Useful for comparing options, but capacity and ceremony rules differ per vessel.

capacity_note: Largest named vessel (Ghost II) up to 110 guests; Legacy up to 80 standing or 24 seated. Most vessels are 36 guests or fewer.
editorial_summary: A superyacht and luxury yacht charter business offering intimate on-deck ceremonies, small receptions and overnight wedding charters, on Sydney Harbour and also Pittwater. Pricing is tailored per package and not published.

capacity_note: Fleet capacity from about 20 to 950 people (The Starship); seated numbers per vessel not published.
price_note: Hourly rates published per vessel from about $1,200 to $5,000 per hour (some plus GST); minimum hours not stated.
editorial_summary: A luxury yacht and function-boat charter company, established in 2010, handling ceremonies on deck, receptions or both. Couples can bring their own florist or stylist, and live music, DJs or fireworks can be added.

capacity_note: Groups from 1 to 950 guests across the fleet; per-vessel capacity not published on the home page.
price_note: No prices published; deposit and bond required. BYO food and drink on most boats with a surcharge.
editorial_summary: A charter agency matching couples with luxury yachts, catamarans and function boats for groups of any size. Most boats allow BYO food and drink for a surcharge, and all central wharves are available for pick-up. Not a members' club despite the name.

capacity_note: Boats take up to about 43-44 guests; seated/standing split not stated.
price_note: From $700 per hour with a 4-hour minimum. BYO food and drink welcome.
editorial_summary: Small catamarans for intimate harbour weddings of up to about 43 guests, with the Opera House and Harbour Bridge as the backdrop. Couples may bring their own food and drink or use partner caterers, and decorations can be arranged.

capacity_note: Sixteen vessels from about 33 to 400 guests; seated/standing split not stated.
price_note: Hourly rates from $700 to about $3,300; 5-hour small-wedding reception tables from about $1,750 to $5,000. Catering from $45 per person; BYO is stated to cut costs. Couples must book their own celebrant.
editorial_summary: A boat-hire booking service with sixteen Sydney vessels, mostly departing from King Street Wharf, where the ceremony usually happens on the upper deck. It publishes per-person cost guides, but the couple supplies their own registered celebrant.

capacity_note: Over 55 catamarans for 12 to 240 guests; function boats listed at 80-185 guests. Seated/standing split not stated.
price_note: From $325 per hour with skipper, crew and fuel; function catamarans from about $650-$1,250 per hour.
editorial_summary: A large catamaran charter company with more than fifty boats for 12 to 240 guests, including function catamarans listed as suitable for weddings. Quotes come back with several matched vessels and ballpark pricing.
